The vector-valued function r(u,v) parametrizes the surface defined in Cartesian coordinates as x3+y3−z2=1 for z>0. What is the third component of r?

a
(u+v)2−13
b
u2+v2−13
c
(u+v)3−1
d
u3+v3−1
e
u2+v2+1
